description: This Java source file implements the DefaultAdapterResolver class, which contains logic for resolving and selecting appropriate Adapter instances based on various attributes of Adaptable objects. It uses complex dispatching mechanisms based on enum attributes and supports fast resolution paths through precomputed maps and recursive selection strategies.

classes.name: DefaultAdapterResolver
classes.description: Final class that implements AdapterResolver interface, providing logic to resolve adapters for Adaptable instances based on configurable attributes.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Returns an Adapter for the given Adaptable by applying the resolver function.

methods.description: Determines if the Adaptable represents a response based on its payload's status presence.

methods.description: Creates a dispatch map based on enum attributes supported by adapters to facilitate fast resolution.

methods.name: selectMatchedAdapters
methods.description: Selects a single adapter from a list or handles no-match/ambiguity cases.

methods.description: Creates a function that evaluates an EnumMap with optional enum support.
